title: Route bulk state updates through the transition chokepoint
description:
Make bulk state updates use the same transition path as single-issue updates instead of re-checking blocking and gates manually.

## Background

`bulk_update.rs:556-576` manually re-checks `is_blocked` plus `has_unpassed_gates()` before Ready/Done transitions instead of routing through `apply_state_transition` in `commands/mod.rs` (the documented state chokepoint that also enforces graph rules and emits events). It reuses the domain predicates, so it agrees today, but it is a second enforcement point that will drift as transition rules evolve.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-1: Bulk updates perform state transitions through the same chokepoint as single-issue transitions; the manual pre-check block is removed.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-2: A bulk item that cannot transition reports the same typed blockers as the equivalent single-issue transition.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-3: A bulk transition emits the same event sequence per issue as the equivalent single transitions, verified by a test comparing event logs.

## Notes

Bulk semantics stay per-item best-effort (one failing item does not abort the batch) unless existing tests specify otherwise; only the enforcement path changes.
